description: Check a proposed action or claim against a fixed set of risk patterns. Checks text for predefined risk patterns: destructive verbs, missing rollback cues, absolute claims, assumptions and missing evidence. Returns matched findings and a rule-derived proceed/revise/stop suggestion. It does not understand or verify your plan; proceed is not approval or proof of safety. Registration required. Live price: see list_treatments.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

subject.description: The plan, action, draft, argument, decision, architecture or answer to review.
